Having deposited say $100,000.00 into an account for 1 month in a bank which offers 18% interest per annum means that within a month, I am able to receive $1,500.00. Clearly withdrawal of this money for use will be haram. However another scenario may arise whereby the same bank might charge me interest for services it may render to me. Lets say this commission amounts to $650.00; the transactions will thus appear like this: DR CR Bal 01/01/2010 10000 10000 31/01/2010 Int. 500 10500 01/02/2010 Withdr 5000 5500 01/02/2010 Charge 250 5250 Which amount can I use for that charge; the $500 or $250, implying am I going to use the intertest to pay for the bank charge or not? answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 39421 Country: India Title: My question is that can I donate the amount of interest in madrasa and if I had already done it what should be done now Question: My question is that can I donate the amount of interest in madrasa and if I had already done it what should be done now. Answer ID: 39421 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 990/990/M=1433) If there are poor and needy students in the madrasa then the interest money may be given to them but it is better not to give such malevolent money to the students of Islamic madrasa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
